backend/main.mo: Main backend actor handling posts, drafts, tagging, user profiles, authorization, and validation utilities.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old user profiles to the new schema while preserving other actor state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a login-update feature with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files, listing roles and responsibilities for each component.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS base setup defining color tokens, dark mode variables, and base element styles.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router setup defining routes, role-based access guards, and layout rendering.
frontend/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx: Auth context provider combining Internet Identity with backend role/profile queries and exposing auth state.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI screen shown when a user lacks required role permissions.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Main app layout with navigation, role-aware menus, profile setup enforcement, and logout handling.
Custom React renderer that parses a subset of markdown syntax into JSX elements, supporting headers, lists, blockquotes, code blocks, inline styles, and links.
frontend/src/components/PostActions.tsx: Component providing edit, publish, unpublish, and delete actions for a post using dropdown menus and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Dialog prompting the user to enter and save their name, with validation and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hooks handling Internet Identity login, stored identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating posts and user profiles through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS base setup defining custom color variables for light and dark themes and global styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminConsolePag: Admin console with tabs for content and user management panels.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ContentManageme: Admin UI for listing, filtering, publishing, unpublishing, and deleting posts with confirmation dialogs and search.
frontend/src/pages/admin/UserManagementP: Static admin panel explaining limited user management features and reliance on backend access control.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login screen offering Internet Identity login and a placeholder username/password form with error handling.
frontend/src/pages/MyPostsPage.tsx: Displays the user's posts with tabs for all, published, and drafts, and provides navigation to create or edit posts.
frontend/src/pages/PostDetailPage.tsx: Shows a single post's full content, metadata, tags, and edit options, handling loading and missing posts.
frontend/src/pages/PostEditorPage.tsx: Form page for creating or editing posts with title, content, and tags, including validation and submit/update actions.
frontend/src/pages/PostsListPage.tsx: Public list of published posts with search, tag filtering, and optional post creation for authorized users.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, storing, clearing, and persisting URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing features, requirements, issues, and versioned state for the internal knowledge base system.
